annotations.title: Compare two US ETFs: overlap and risk

description: Any two covered US ETFs: holdings overlap measured three ways (by weight, and the share of each fund held in common), the largest shared holdings, the correlation and covariance of weekly returns, and the cost, return and risk of each.

a.description: A US ETF ticker, for example VOO. Case does not matter.
